upstreams.fields: GTFS agency, routes, trips, stop_times, stops, calendar, calendar_dates — compiled to minute-resolution patterns over a 14-day window

cadenceBasis.observed: data.gouv.fr states frequency «daily»; the GTFS resource was last modified 2026-11-19 (read 2026-11-21). The bundle holds a 14-day window (WINDOW_DAYS), so it is rebuilt every three days: the window never has fewer than 11 days left, and a date beyond it is refused (js/transit-raptor.js coverage)
cadenceBasis.expires: if the publisher moves to a different schedule, or WINDOW_DAYS changes

autoRefresh: one dataset-API request (www.data.gouv.fr) and one archive download, no key; the dataset licence is re-read and the build refuses any change from odc-odbl; the archive must contain a calendar covering a day from today on, and nothing is written when any of that fails
schema: scripts/build-transit-timetables.mjs (stops [name, lat*1e5, lon*1e5, group]; patterns {r, s, f, t}) — read by js/transit-raptor.js; tests/transit-timetable-checks.test.mjs
